songs.title: Hush Now, My Love
songs.stylePrompt: warm melodic pop, I-V-vi-IV progression, stop-time break before the final chorus, textured mood
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1: Male Vocal]
Dear one, your shoulder brushes mine
The porch chain answers with a sigh
Your ribbon moves against the screen
I ask if you can hear the sky
You laugh and look away again
I keep my courage near
Your sleeve touches mine, then settles
The porch smells of rain and roses
[Chorus: Male and Female Duet]
The doorway holds our borrowed hush
Hush Now, My Love
A little ring of dusk around us
Turns a nervous breath to trust
[Verse 2: Female Vocal]
Dear one, your fingers wait beside me
Close enough to start a spark
My blush is safer in the corner
Where the roses hide the dark
Say one small word and I will answer
Let the new road start
[Chorus: Male and Female Duet]
The old swing moves, then slows for us
Hush Now, My Love
Your hand finds mine without a speech
And all the porch turns bright
[Instrumental Break]
[Final Chorus: Male and Female Duet Harmony]
Hush Now, My Love
The doorway keeps our first sweet secret
I will know this touch for years
Hush Now, My Love
